name: forfettario-art15-disbursement
description: Forfettario, private client: fee 10 h × €50.00 = €500.00 (N2.2) and a €50.00 court fee paid in the client's name (reimbursement, default treatment excluded -> N1). The disbursement counts for the stamp duty threshold (Risposta 491/2021): 500.00 + 50.00 = 550.00 > 77.47, €2.00 charged and allocated to N2.2 (part of the fee, Risposta 428/2022). Total 500.00 + 50.00 + 2.00 = €552.00; taxable base 500.00.
